Tas mam best in a word. For MGR sir, u have to work really hard but he is fair enough. Understanding his lecture is tough unless you are very good at accounting. Oiling won't work like what u did for rkb sir and I don't know about other two. But I want to say, 368 is fully project base course. Try to get enrolled into a best group. If possible take the interview first whether they are capable of making a impressive financial part or not. Good luck.
